## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Pabhassaravimānavatthu* ("Shining Mansion", Vv 40) is a verse text belonging to the *Vimānavatthu* in the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya. Its theme concerns how devas endowed with firm confidence in the Supreme Buddha outshine other celestial beings.

In later exegetical and comparative contexts, Dhammapāla's commentary on the *Pabhassaravimāna* narrative relates the story of a woman who had the opportunity to hear the Dhamma from the elder Mahāmoggallāna but neglected it; Anne E. Monius notes that this motif of a missed spiritual opportunity parallels a passage in the Tamil Buddhist epic *Maṇimēkalai* (x.33–34) [Monius 2001].

 DharmaNexus identifies 19 internal Pali text-reuse matches (2,005 characters) shared with the *Vimānavatthu-aṭṭhakathā*, with the longest shared unit occurring between §3.4–8.2 and the commentary [DharmaNexus].
